SELECT t.categoryName, COUNT(d.category) AS count FROM ( SELECT '技术需求' AS categoryName, 1 AS code UNION ALL SELECT '研究需求' AS categoryName, 2 AS code UNION ALL SELECT '创新创意' AS categoryName, 3 AS code UNION ALL SELECT '其他' AS categoryName, 4 AS code ) t LEFT JOIN demand d ON t.code = d.category GROUP BY t.categoryName, t.code ORDER BY t.code
